I received this full sized product in one of my Ipsy bags. I'd never heard of Elizabeth Mott before, but I'd definitely recommend. Hopefully they expand their product line. This is my favorite neutral shadow, sparkly without looking like a hooker! I also like to use this as a highlighter - it's about the same color on my fair skin as the Benefit Watts Up stick that costs 3x as much.

I love this shadow color.  This was the second time I purchased it.  The first time it broke into little pieces, and I had to fix it several times.  But i gave it the benefit of the doubt and purchased it again and the same thing happened even though it was in a different holder. If it didn't break both times I would have given this product a 5 star.

This is one of my wife's favorite eye shadows.  She uses it regularly and sometimes it can be hard to find in the right shade at our local retailers.  I buy her 2 or 3 every year and put them in her stocking at Christmas.  She know's it will be there, but she certainly appreciates not having to go out and buy it herself.

This is a must have in my makeup bag- it is just shimmery enough!  It is perfect for both day and night wear.  My favorite thing about this eyeshadow is that it is light, and does not settle into the creases, and wrinkles around my eyes.  (which is a common problem I have with shimmery eye shadow.)

This is the best eye shadow I have ever had. Hands down. It's so smooth, and silky! It stays put all day, and the color is beautiful! I would call it luminous peach. My skin tone is pretty close to albino, and my eyes are a really light greenish yellow color. This color is the perfect complement for my fair complexion, but I do think it would look great on anyone, and for tanner skin, it would make a great face highlighter.  If you are on the fence, BUY THIS SHADOW!

reviews.t: Beautiful color, but doesn't stay where put
reviews.x: My only complaint about this eyeshadow is that it is so light and glittery that it rarely stays only where I put it. Within minutes, my glasses and rest of my face have a slight shimmer (the glasses have to be cleaned about an hour after application otherwise it's annoying). This isn't necessarily a bad thing, but an unexpected thing.
I love this beautiful champagne color. It has great pigmentation and is perfect for a natural daytime look. Also, it can easily be a base for a great smokey eye for nightime. Love it!
Came in all broken and fell out all over when I opened it. Love the color, though.
When the package arrived I opened my pop goes the shawdow and it was broke

This was a beautiful Pop of Color on my eyelids and the inner corners of my eyes to give me that awake look without being too made up.  I also have experimented with Champagne and put a little on the bridge of my nose as a highlight and over the top of a matte lipstick on my cupid's bow and the center of the lower lip to give a fuller lip look without the shininess of a gloss.  Just a pop of highlight to brighten up the face.  Great formulation, good color saturation and easy application.  Yay!

I highly recommend pop! goes the shadow because unlike many products out there, it does EVERYTHING it claims to do: it blends and goes on effortlessly, is highly pigmented and lasts ALL DAY with ZERO CREASING!!! I've had bad experiences with many eye shadows that creased in the past so it is absolutely relieving to find a product that actually works to address my very concern! I don’t go wild over crazy colors all over my eyes.  It just doesn’t look natural.  However, this shade was perfect for me.  It was light in color, but still added the perfect hint of sparkle as it has a nice glittery effect.  It also didn’t cake all over my eyelids, either.  I think if I was a little bit braver, I could mix it with another darker color to give some contrast…  (probably need to visit some Pinterest boards for some DIY inspiration!)  While I love this product from Elizabeth Mott,

Champagne is a wonderful eyeshadow. It's not so off-colored that it appears white on my eyelids... it's more of a peachy color with some shimmer. I don't really care for colorful eyeshadows, as they take away from my dramatic eyeliner, so this is the absolute perfect color if you just want to put a little something on to make the look, well, look complete. It's a great color!

reviews.t: Good quality, shipped in poor condition. Love the product though
reviews.x: I gave this a 3 because I like the shadow, but it was shattered when it arrived. It came with another that was intact so it didn't happen in shipping. I used alcohol to kind of fix it because my only other option was a refund and wait again for another instead of exchange. I do like the color and shimmer, and will keep buying it if the next one comes intact.

I originally got this through Ipsy and absolutely loved it. Found out I could get it on here and was super happy! It's literally the best eye shadow. Perfect for any occasion! Lasts all day. Travels nicely too! Mine hasn't broken on any trips I've taken, which most eyeshadows/powders do! Once I'm out I will be buying more for sure!
I love this eyeshadow! I first got it in an Ipsy box and have ordered it twice since. It's a beautiful shimmer that doesn't look juvenile. It highlights by brow bone and inside of my eye perfectly.
I absolutely love this eye shadow. That is why I bought more of it. The only issue I had was both containers of it were all cracked. That upset me, but the eye shadow itself I love
My new favorite eye shadow! Great amount of shimmer and it's has a cute packaging. I like the creamy texture and how it just applies on smoothly. Great product, Elizabeth Mott!

reviews.t: Good things come in SMALL packages
reviews.x: This shadow glides on smoothly, and the subtle hue is a great all-over lid color. Was disappointed in the tiny size of the compact, however.

reviews.t: Beautiful cosmetic with a snazzy box
reviews.x: Love the eyeshadow, its color, its box, its brand, just wish it was a matte.
Sooo shiny! Just what I wanted. Perfect corner eye shimmer.
I love the shadow, but when I recieved it it was broken.  😢
Great color and not too sparkly. Goes on super smooth.

I knew what to expect from the color of this shadow because I was replacing a pan of it that I dropped and broke all over the floor.  Champagne is a peachy-pink neutral tone similar in its degree of shimmer (but not its color) to Stila Kitten. It's slightly lighter than my natural eyelid color so I like to use it over the lid for a brightening but neutral/ "natural" toned look. claims.text: Many reviewers love the color and shimmer, describing it as a flattering neutral/champagne shade that works for day and night looks.
Several reviewers praise the smooth, blendable, long-lasting formula that stays put all day without creasing.
A notable number of reviewers report the eyeshadow arrived broken or shattered, which was disappointing.
Some reviewers note the shadow is so light and glittery that it doesn't stay only where applied and can spread shimmer elsewhere.
Customer service is praised for being helpful and replacing broken products.
